newsitem.title: FRANCE: French assembly on holiday till September.
newsitem.headline: French assembly on holiday till September.

text.p: France's newly-elected deputies went on holiday on Wednesday after a brief first session of the National Assembly and were not expected to meet again until mid-September.
The 577-seat assembly, elected on May 25-June 1 in a poll that swept the right from power, only held a few meetings over the past two weeks.
The Socialist-led government, waiting for an audit of public finances at mid-July to start drafting bills, decided against calling an emergency summer session of parliament.
